dedupe_keys.name: recommendation itu r bt 1774 3 use of satellite and terrestrial broadcast infrastructures for public warning disaster mitigation and relief 2025

description: This ITU-R Recommendation gives the characteristics of satellite and terrestrial broadcasting systems used for public warning, disaster mitigation and relief operations. Its scope statement says detailed descriptions of the systems are given in Annex 1 as guidance and are also found in section 5 of Report ITU-R BT.2299. The keywords are public warning, emergency warning system (EWS) and automatic receiver activation, and the acronym list shows the systems covered, including the automatic emergency alert service, ATSC 3.0 advanced emergency alerting, the Common Alerting Protocol and mobile alert systems. The 39-page document is the third revision, dated February 2025, after versions of 2007 and 2015. Producer: ITU-R, answering questions 56-4/6, 136-3/6 and 290/4. Coverage: global. Access: free PDF; the foreword, scope, keywords and acronym list were read, and Annex 1 was not read in full. Licence and cost: free to download; all rights reserved. Caveats: a technical standard describing systems, not data; details of each system were not verified. Simulation uses: the system characteristics define alerting channels and receiver behaviour for emergency-response models. Related record: ITU-R Report BT.2299-4 (data-itu-r-bt-2299-4-broadcasting-public-warning-disaster-mitigation-relief).
